en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 8. My father (RA) said: `Ali ibn Ibrahim said, on the authority of his father, on the authority of Ibn Abu `Umayr, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Khath`ami, on the authority of `Abd al-Rahim al-Qasir

that I asked Abu Ja`far al-Baqir (AS) something about Divine Unity. He lifted his hands up to Heaven and said: “Exalted is Allah, the Supreme [Jabbar]. Verily, whoever speculates about Divine Unity will be destroyed.”
